name: leetcode-companion
description: Local-first LeetCode preparation dashboard with automatic attempt tracking

scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate && npm run dev -w @lcc/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lcc/web && npm run ext:build
scripts.start: npm run db:migrate && npm run start -w @lcc/web
scripts.app: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/scheduler && tsc -p packages/db && tsc -p apps/extension && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
